create_MetricUpdateBase: create a MetricUpdateBase transform to run a torchmetrics Metric on a NamedContext with configurable update or forward behavior
create_MetricUpdate: create a MetricUpdate transform to update a torchmetrics Metric without computing the result
create_MetricUpdateAndCompute: create a MetricUpdateAndCompute transform to update and compute a torchmetrics Metric in one step
build_metric_transform_pipeline: build a transform pipeline using MetricUpdateBase subclasses to accumulate and compute metrics on NamedContext data
test_MetricUpdateBase: test the MetricUpdateBase class validates that the metric argument is an instance of torchmetrics.Metric
